close_reason: Fixed: changed find_cert_ext to try_find_cert_ext for PolicyMappings, PolicyConstraints (per-loop and §6.1.5(b)), and InhibitAnyPolicy in pkix-path/src/lib.rs
description: File: pkix-path/src/lib.rs. find_cert_ext silently returns None on malformed extensions, but for security-critical extensions (PolicyConstraints, PolicyMappings, InhibitAnyPolicy) a malformed value should cause rejection, not silent ignore.
